mechanicalVerdict.evidence: All locked length, structure, metadata, detail, source, and contrast-skeleton checks pass.

evidence: The two official date formulations are preserved rather than collapsed.

narrativeVerdict.coreQuestion: 为什么《太阳少女》中最抢眼的不是人物的表情，而是身体边缘那圈强光？

paragraphDependency.paragraph: The opening deep paragraph establishes the displaced facial focus and explains how edge light, vegetation, and internal shadow produce volume.
paragraphDependency.dependsOn: The quick layer's provisional answer that edge light is the viewing mechanism.
paragraphDependency.newUnderstanding: The bright edge is not merely an outline; it models bodily turning and volume.
paragraphDependency.breaksIfMovedEarlier: Without the visible tension, the technical description lacks a reason for attention.

paragraphDependency.paragraph: The forest paragraph makes the setting part of the same light-dark mechanism and limits claims about the source direction.
paragraphDependency.dependsOn: The prior paragraph's account of the body's edge and internal shadow.
paragraphDependency.newUnderstanding: Body and forest are connected by one contrast system rather than treated as figure plus incidental background.
paragraphDependency.breaksIfMovedEarlier: The reader would not yet know which edge and tonal transition the setting is helping to explain.

paragraphDependency.paragraph: The career-history section introduces restricted access to life training and professional exhibitions, then returns that context to the depicted body and light handling.
paragraphDependency.dependsOn: The established visual mechanism and the question of why this treatment matters beyond appearance.
paragraphDependency.newUnderstanding: The same nude acquires a production-history dimension without becoming an unsupported political declaration.
paragraphDependency.breaksIfMovedEarlier: Placed first, it would read as detachable biography before the work-specific visual problem exists.

paragraphDependency.paragraph: The Bouguereau comparison tests the mechanism and institutional context against the nearest in-museum comparator.
paragraphDependency.dependsOn: Both the light mechanism and the access-history context have already been established.
paragraphDependency.newUnderstanding: The work's museum-specific value lies in a concrete difference in light/color treatment and in who could enter the nude tradition.
paragraphDependency.breaksIfMovedEarlier: The comparison would become a checklist item because its two decisive axes would not yet be available.

paragraphDependency.paragraph: The significance paragraph calibrates the result as an important collection node, not a nationally unique masterpiece.
paragraphDependency.dependsOn: The formal return and comparator boundary established in all preceding paragraphs.
paragraphDependency.newUnderstanding: The label is justified by specific museum value while remaining inside the Frye 72-point boundary.
paragraphDependency.breaksIfMovedEarlier: The importance label would precede the evidence that earns it.

narrativeVerdict.reorderingTest: The historical-context and comparison paragraphs lose their explanatory premises if moved before the visual mechanism; the significance paragraph cannot move earlier without becoming an unsupported label.
narrativeVerdict.quickDeepLastLookRoles: Quick gives a complete provisional answer; deep independently rebuilds and extends it through mechanism, institutional history, and comparison; the last look turns those results into a specific shoulder-and-edge viewing action.

nativeChineseVerdict.hardGateBasis: Canonical section 6.3 requires translationeseFindings to be empty and the title, quick layer, and paragraph transitions to read naturally aloud.

significanceVerdict.label: 重要藏品

fiveDimensions.artisticAchievement: The draft identifies a concrete formal achievement: edge light, internal shadow, and dark green-brown vegetation jointly establish contrast, turning, volume, and outdoor light.
fiveDimensions.artHistoricalPosition: It places the work in Genth's approximately age-33 period of building a reputation through outdoor female nudes, while avoiding claims of a singular masterpiece or turning point.
fiveDimensions.historicalCulturalValue: It connects the nude to restricted access for women to life training and professional exhibitions, while explicitly declining to convert that context into a political manifesto.
fiveDimensions.rarityAndIrreplaceability: It names the nearest comparator and limits non-substitutability to the Frye pairing's distinct light/color method and artist-access context; it explicitly rejects national uniqueness.
fiveDimensions.collectionPosition: It identifies the work as a Founding Collection node whose value is strengthened by a specific in-museum comparison.

significanceVerdict.nearestComparator: William-Adolphe Bouguereau, Dans les bois (In the Woods), Frye Art Museum
significanceVerdict.sharedCore: Idealized female nude in a woodland setting.
significanceVerdict.decisiveDifference: Sun Maiden relies more directly on outdoor color-light and the strongly lit body edge; Genth's access to professional nude training and exhibition changes the institutional meaning of the pairing.
significanceVerdict.nonSubstitutabilityBoundary: The comparator can supply the woodland-nude subject but not this exact conjunction of Genth's light treatment and the in-museum contrast in artists' access conditions. This supports an important-collection label only, not national or global uniqueness.
significanceVerdict.frye72Calibration: The prose avoids rare-treasure, world-class, itinerary-deciding, and must-see-isolate language.

workSpecificVerdict.evidence: The core question, shoulder/back edge light, green-brown vegetation, internal tonal transition, Genth's career context, and the same-museum Bouguereau comparator make the argument non-transferable to a generic nude painting.

independenceChecks.card: PASS — an independent value judgment explaining why the work merits opening; it is not an excerpt or guide-command opening.
independenceChecks.quickLayer: PASS — independently states why to look and what visible mechanism supplies the payoff.
independenceChecks.deepLayer: PASS — remains intelligible without the quick layer and adds causal visual analysis, institutional history, comparison, and calibrated importance.
independenceChecks.lastLook: PASS — supplies a work-specific shoulder-to-edge tracing action and a changed judgment rather than repeating the opening.

entrance.evidence: “人物把面容转离观者，最醒目的信息便落到身体边缘” immediately establishes a visible, specific problem.

causality.evidence: The draft explains how dark vegetation increases the skin's brightness, how shadow preserves volume, and why those facts lead into the institutional comparison.

human.evidence: Women's restricted access to life training and professional exhibitions is connected to Genth's ability to build a career with this subject.

turn.evidence: The reader moves from treating the bright edge as an eye-catching outline to understanding it as the joint mechanism for body, forest, and career context.

visualPayoff.evidence: Every contextual move returns to shoulder/back edge light, internal shadow, skin brightness, or green-brown vegetation.

spokenClarity.evidence: Most sentences are clear, but phrases such as “职业条件落实成可见的光色处理” and “作者准入” are abstract and unnatural when read aloud.

secondLook.evidence: The ending directs the reader to begin at the shoulder/back, trace the changing bright edge, and notice where shadow and vegetation interrupt it.

failureReasons.reason: The visitor prose contains multiple abstract, compressed phrases that do not read naturally aloud: “职业条件落实成可见的光色处理”, “进入学院裸体传统的职业条件”, “作者准入”, and “题材显出……生产条件”.
failureReasons.action: Return the work to drafting and replace those research-label abstractions with natural spoken Chinese that names the people, access restrictions, and visible painting actions directly; then rerun the full independent review. Do not merely swap connectors or add qualifiers.

finalRationale: The direct-upstream chain, mechanical gates, fact boundaries, narrative dependency, significance calibration, work specificity, production-language scan, and 13/14 voice threshold pass. The canonical native-Chinese hard gate fails because translationeseFindings is nonempty and the affected passages do not read naturally aloud; any hard-gate failure requires final FAIL.
